text: Juan Manuel Barrientos Valencia is a Colombian chef and businessman, known by the nickname "Juanma." He was born in Medellín, Colombia, and completed his education at Colegiatura Colombiana in Medellín and Mariano Moreno in Buenos Aires. In 2006, he founded the El Cielo restaurant chain. In 2015, he opened the original El Cielo Miami, which was awarded a Michelin star in Florida's first-ever Michelin Guide in 2022. He has been recognized as one of the 50 best chefs of Latin America and received the Revelation Chef Award from Madrid Fusion. He is also a recipient of a Michelin Award. One of his projects is titled "In El Cielo, estamos cocinando la paz de Colombia," which translates to "In El Cielo, we are cooking up peace in Colombia."
